outputs.explanation: Panel A is a schematic illustration of the experimental pipeline, not a plot; individual data points are not applicable.
Panel B consists of representative micrograph/imaging photos (fluorescence, H&E, bright-field), not a plot of averaged data.
Panel C is a bar chart showing mean lactate concentration with 95% CI for Normal, LUAD, and LUSC groups, and individual data points (colored dots) are overlaid on each bar.
Panel D is a bar chart showing mean lactate concentration with 95% CI for high pH and low pH regions, and individual data points (colored dots) are overlaid on each bar.
Panel E is a schematic diagram illustrating the immunosuppressive niche model, not a plot of quantitative data.
